Common Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does an inspection take?

Most inspections take 30–60 minutes depending on roof size and access. You'll get a written summary the same day.

Do you provide a written quote before any work starts?

Yes. Every job — repair or replacement — gets an itemized, written scope and price before we schedule anything.

What if a storm has already damaged my roof?

We document the damage with photos and a written assessment you can share with your insurance provider.

How far in advance should I schedule a replacement?

We recommend reaching out as soon as you notice an issue. Timelines depend on season and material availability, which we'll confirm at your inspection.

Do you clean up the site each day?

Yes. Crews clear debris and run a magnetic nail sweep at the end of each work day.
